title.suggested: McCoole and Allen Sign Articles for Fight

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted its report that Mike McCoole and Tom Allen met Saturday at Coyne's saloon and made a match for $2,500 a side, the fight to take place near St. Louis on September 13.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Daily Democrat, Monday Morning, May 30, 1870.' Before the 1875 merger, so not the Globe-Democrat. Reprint of the May 29 article (407), with 'yesterday' changed to 'Saturday'.

facts.fact: Allen and Mike McCoole signed articles at Coyne's saloon for a rematch for $2,500 a side, each putting up $500, the fight to take place near St. Louis on September 13
places: Coyne's saloon, Third Street near the post office, St. Louis

notes: Duplicate of article 407 (same text, one day later); consider whether both should stay. Current title 'Try Their Mettle' is less informative than 407's.
